meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist statutory legal tradition; unitary national system; subordinate decrees and circulars implement statutes)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 14 December 2022 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 10 May 2023 detailing beneficiary-owner identification, PEP management, risk classification and reporting duties; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020 (members' registers and UBO disclosure of LLCs); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP dated 4 January 2021 on enterprise registration; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020; implementing directives of the State Bank of Viet Nam and the State Inspectorate on AML/CFT customer due diligence and record-keeping.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or business-registration authority of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the shareholder's jurisdiction is party to the 1961 Apostille Convention; otherwise consular legalization at the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by notarized true-copy certification in Viet Nam

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Investor Approval authorizing the investment in Viet Nam, the proposed company name, registered office and appointment of the legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors or corporate secretary of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; additionally notarized in Viet Nam with certified Vietnamese translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited Financial Statements (latest 1–2 years) or funding plan of the foreign investor for the DPI investment appraisal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent auditor registered in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille/consular legalization of the auditor's certification; Vietnamese translation certified by a Vietnamese notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vietnamese legal representative and incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate shareholder or individual shareholders

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or competent public authority of the holder's country of citizenship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization where required; final notarization of the copies and Vietnamese translation in Viet Nam

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all disclosable shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, legal representatives, directors and key government-relations counterparties at and above the 25% UBO threshold against: (i) the national PEP database administered under Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP and supervised by the State Bank of Viet Nam; (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) the US OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists to the extent the LLC will transact in USD or receive retainer wires; and (iv) the domestic negative/sanctions list of the Ministry of Public Security and the State Bank of Viet Nam. The Medium_Risk_Enhanced profile requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification for inbound capital and retainer payments, ongoing transaction monitoring, and re-verification of beneficial ownership every 12 months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal — Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn), administered with the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province where the LLC's headquarters are located
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Articles 38–40 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 22–23 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the statutory name of the limited liability company must consist of (i) the legal type element 'Công ty trách nhiệm hữu hạn' or the abbreviated 'Công ty TNHH' and (ii) a proper name written in Vietnamese alphabet letters and Vietnamese pronunciation; the proper name may include numerals and the permitted Latin letters F, J, Z and W and must not be merely a description of business lines. An optional additional foreign-language name in Latin script is permitted but must be consistent with the Vietnamese registered name. For a foreign-invested LLC in government-relations advisory, the DPI expects a Vietnamese transliteration of the foreign corporate name; names identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise (including, for five years, the name of a dissolved enterprise in the same province) are rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Chính phủ (Government) — prohibited or requires prior ministerial authorization when implying state authority
Quốc hội (National Assembly) — prohibited for commercial entities
Nhà nước (State) — prohibited when implying state ownership or a state agency
Bộ / Tổng cục / Cục (Ministry / General Department / Department) — restricted, requires prior state-agency authorization
Bộ Công an (Ministry of Public Security) — prohibited
Bộ Quốc phòng (Ministry of National Defence) — prohibited
Quân đội (Armed Forces) — prohibited for private commercial entities
Công an (Public Security) — restricted and generally prohibited
An ninh (National Security) — sensitive token implying a state body; requires clearance
Ngân hàng (Bank) — requires prior license of the State Bank of Viet Nam
Bảo hiểm (Insurance) — requires prior license of the Ministry of Finance
Chứng khoán (Securities) — requires prior license of the State Securities Commission
Kiểm toán (Audit) — restricted to licensed audit firms
Luật / Luật sư (Law / Attorney) — restricted to licensed law practitioners
Viện kiểm sát / Tòa án (Procuratorate / Court) — prohibited for commercial enterprises
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Vietnamese law does not issue a standalone name-reservation certificate; name clearance occurs integrally within the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) procedures. Procedural instructions: (1) conduct a preliminary name search on the National Business Registration Portal against both the provincial DPI register and the national register, retaining an alternative backup name; (2) file the IRC dossier with the proposed Vietnamese name and, after IRC issuance, submit the ERC application online within 30 days; (3) if the DPI rejects the proposed name, the applicant may cure the defect by resubmitting a corrected name within the statutory three-working-day online correction window, or otherwise re-file the ERC dossier; (4) where the rejection arises from a material legal defect, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal to the Director of the DPI under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 30 days of the rejection notice, with a further appeal to the Provincial People's Committee and eventual judicial review at the competent administrative court; (5) as a recommended fallback, the incorporating law firm should propose a distinctive coined transliteration or trade-mark-style mark and, for dual protection, file a Vietnamese wordmark in class 35 simultaneously with the ERC application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole statutory headquarters of the foreign-invested LLC in the target scope. Article 44 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 requires a physical head-office address in Viet Nam for service of legal process and official documentation. Serviced offices and co-working leases are tolerated for low-footprint consulting entities only with a valid registered lease and verifiable landlord documentation. For ISIC 7020 government-relations advisory, the DPI, tax authorities and the State Inspectorate expect an operational presence, meeting capability, resident local compliance staff and accessible records; a pure virtual mailbox or mail-forwarding post-box is high-risk and may invalidate the registered address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 60–70% within the first 12 months post-incorporation for the Medium_Risk_Enhanced profile and the politically sensitive advisory scope; triggers include post-registration FDI performance checks by the DPI, headquarters tax inspections by the General Department of Taxation, and unannounced AML/CFT record-keeping visits by the State Inspectorate or the State Bank of Viet Nam.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) — application and issuance fee for the foreign-invested LLC under Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the provincial People's Committee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (approximately 250,000 VND per certificate, as adjusted from time to time)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) — name clearance, dossier review and registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (50,000–100,000 VND under the Ministry of Finance fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of establishment on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory zero-fee (online publication included in the ERC procedure)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and certified Vietnamese translation of the apostilled corporate KYC bundle (certificate of incorporation, incumbency, board resolution, POA and ID copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed notary office in Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (approximately 1.5–2 million VND per dossier)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (effective 1 January 2021): Articles 43–57 (limited liability company rules), Article 26 (enterprise registration processing), Articles 74–77 (charter capital and contribution); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14: Articles 37–42 (investment registration for foreign investors); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT (forms and fees).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the head office is located; given the cross-border character, the Ho Chi Minh City DPI or Hanoi DPI will be the likely registry; online filing via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) administered by the Agency for Business Registration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1) and Application for Investment Registration (Form I-1/A) as prescribed by Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT and Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHDT respectively, filed through the National Business Registration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to a government-relations advisory LLC (ISIC 7020) under Article 74 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; the registered charter capital must be rationally commensurate with the scale and objectives of the business, must be fully contributed in cash within 90 days from the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, and must be remitted from the foreign investor's account to the company's corporate bank account in Viet Nam; no escrow account is required, the activity being a wholly unrestricted service sector open to 100% foreign ownership.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION NO. 01-2025 OF THE BOARD OF MEMBERS OF [COMPANY NAME] LLC (the 'Company'), ADOPTED AT [CITY], VIET NAM, ON [DATE].

WHEREAS the Company is being incorporated under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 as a limited liability company pursuing, inter alia, the business line ISIC 7020 — business and management consultancy activities, encompassing cross-border trade policy analysis and foreign stakeholder government affairs lobbying advisory; and no minimum charter capital is imposed by law;

NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED THAT:

1. SUBSCRIPTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL: the charter capital of the Company is fixed at USD [___]; the members present hereby subscribe to the entire charter capital and undertake to contribute such capital to the Company's corporate bank account within 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate date; no cash consideration is outstanding.

2. REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered head office of the Company shall be situated at [floor, building, street, ward, district, city], Viet Nam; the Board of Members authorizes the General Director to execute, register and renew the lease of such premises and to establish branch or representative offices as required.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: [Name A] is appointed as the sole Legal Representative / General Director (Chief Executive Officer), [Name B] is appointed as Deputy/Alternate Legal Representative, and [Name C] is appointed as Chief Accountant; such officers are granted full power to open bank accounts, sign contracts, engage counsel and notaries, submit and respond to all filings and pay all fees before the DPI and any tax or licencing authority, and receive the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

4. GOVERNANCE AND RESERVED MATTERS: all management powers not reserved by the Board of Members under the Company Charter are delegated to the General Director; matters falling outside the ordinary course of business require prior written consent of the Board of Members.

5. SEAL, LETTERHEADS AND REGISTERS: the General Director is directed to procure the company seal, statutory registers, accounting vouchers and corporate letterheads in compliance with Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.

6. RATIFICATION AND POWERS: any acts performed between the date of this Resolution and the date of the Enterprise Registration Certificate for the purpose of statutory incorporation and licensing are hereby ratified in full.

RESOLVED AND ADOPTED on the date first written above.

[Signature] ______________________
[Name A], Chairman of the Board of Members / Sole Member of [COMPANY NAME] LLC

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-filing Name Search and Trade Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) operated by the Business Registration Office, DPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an electronic search of the proposed Vietnamese trade name together with the company type identifier 'Công ty TNHH' (LLC). Articles 38–42 of the Law on Enterprises prohibit the registration of a name identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered enterprise. Reserve the chosen name within the application; include an alias or English name if necessary.
required_dossiers: Proposed name in Vietnamese with LLC designation
English name/alias of the company
Search result report from the National Portal (confirming availability)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as identical or confusingly similar, submit a revised name together with a comparative explanation distinguishing the new name; request a written refusal and appeal to the Director of the DPI within 30 days under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) Application for the Foreign-Invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); if the project is located in an export processing zone (EPE), the Management Board of the Export Processing/Industrial Zone
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before enterprise registration, the foreign investor must submit an investment registration dossier pursuant to Articles 37–42 of the Law on Investment. Indicate 'Market access conditions: unrestricted — full ownership permitted for trade policy consultancy services (ISIC 7020)' and present the government affairs advisory scope. The competent authority will issue the IRC within 15 days of receipt of a complete dossier.
required_dossiers: Investment Registration Application (Form I-1/A)
Notarized Power of Attorney to the filer
Certificate of incorporation/business registration and board resolution of the foreign investor (apostilled/legalized, with notarized Vietnamese translation)
Latest audited financial statements of the investor or certified proof of funds
Investment project proposal setting out location, head office, workforce and phasing
Draft Company Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the DPI issues a request for rectification, the applicant has 30 days to amend and re-submit under Article 39 of the Law on Investment; an IRC refusal may be appealed to the Minister of Planning and Investment or challenged through administrative court proceedings under Law No. 24/2011/QH13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Company Charter and Foundation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial State Notary Public Office or a licensed Notary Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company Charter, member list, capital contribution table and consent documents of the legal representatives must be notarized under Law No. 29/2014/QH13 and Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT. For a corporate member, the foreign company's articles and board resolution approving the investment must be notarized and translated.
required_dossiers: Original IRC
Draft Company Charter executed by all members
Member list and contribution table (Form I-3)
Legal representative list (Form I-4)
Notarized identification documents of all members and officers
Corporate resolution and valid authority of each foreign corporate member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary demands excess additional evidence, the applicant may object and request written reasons; refusal may be appealed to the Department of Justice of the province under Law on Notarization within 60 days, or the applicant may approach another licensed notary office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) Submission and Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete enterprise registration dossier after the IRC is issued, within 30 days. The DPI has 3 working days (online) or 5 working days (paper) to issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate. Once issued, the LLC attains legal personality. The registration fee is zero for online lodgment.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Notarized Company Charter
Form I-3: List of members and capital contributions
Form I-4: List of legal representatives
Original IRC
Notarized copies of identification of the members and the legal representatives
Power of Attorney to the corporate lawyer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a notice of insufficiency, the applicant may cure within 30 days; failing that, the dossier lapses and must be refiled. A refusal can be administratively appealed to the DPI Director within 30 days and then to the court under the Law on Administrative Procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Activation: Tax Code, Company Seal, and Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation (via automatic portal integration), licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam (SBV), licensed seal engraving establishment approved by the DPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On ERC issuance, tax registration is automatic and the 13-digit enterprise tax code is generated; the Company must simultaneously carve its seal, file seal registration within a few days, open an onshore VND/USD corporate bank account, and effect the wire transfer of charter capital within 90 days from the ERC date. All capital movements must be documented for foreign exchange control (SBV Circular No. 03/2021/TT-NHNN).
required_dossiers: ERC certificate
Board Resolution approving the opening of bank accounts and seal design
Lease agreement of the head office registered with the authority
Certificates of incorporation and passport copies of the general director and authorized signatories
AML/KYC profile — Projected client base (retainer-wire model) confirming Medium Risk Enhanced handling
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax code is not automatically activated, apply directly at the local tax office with the ERC; if the bank raises enhanced due diligence queries, supplement with the IRC/ERC and source of funds evidence; such action can be remedied by providing the complete corporate file within a 10-day statutory expectation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Physical Premises Compliance and Fire-Safety Clearance for the Head Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention, Fighting and Rescue Police Department (C04/Vietnam People's Public Security) and District Police; construction-management authority of the People's Committee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As a professional advisory office, the Company's physical licence is obtained by proving the lease is legally valid and undergoing fire-safety design appraisal and acceptance under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP. The building owner's fire approval is relied on where the building has a valid certificate; the Company must also register its workplace labour-safety file with the local Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs.
required_dossiers: Head-office lease contract and certificate of floor ownership/rental consent
Fire-safety design appraisal file (or building owner's certificate as annex)
Certificate of fire-fighting system completion / acceptance
Workplace health & safety declaration per Law No. 84/2015/QH13
Notice of structural load and occupancy for the leased floors
Appointment of the safety coordinator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire-safety inspection identifies deficiencies, the Company is granted a corrective period to install or repair extinguishers, emergency exit lighting and signage; after re-inspection, the certificate is issued. A refusal may be appealed to the Director of the Provincial Police within 5 days; failure to operate without clearance carries administrative penalties up to VND 60 million.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) — Business Registration Office (principal industrial licensing body for service operations); Ministry of Public Security for fire-safety clearance; Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs for occupational safety. No separate manufacturing or import/export license applies to government-relations advisory (ISIC 7020), which is an unrestricted sector under Viet Nam's WTO schedule.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enterprise Registration Certificate together with the Investment Registration Certificate — together constituting the statutory operating licence for a foreign-invested limited liability company carrying on business and management consultancy activities (ISIC 7020), including cross-border trade policy analysis and foreign stakeholder lobbying advisory services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) and the Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EXEMPT — Category III (office-based, no production) under Annex V of Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP; the Company does not trigger a full EIA report or an environmental licence because the head office is a leased commercial space producing only household-grade wastewater (below 200 m³/day), no boilers, no VOCs, no dust-generation equipment and no industrial solid waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance standards applicable: municipal wastewater quality per QCVN 14-MT:2015/BTNMT for domestic discharge; occupational noise within QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT; office hazardous wastes (batteries, cartridges, e-waste) must be stored in segregated bins and transferred to a MONRE-licensed transporter per Circular No. 02/2022/TT-BTNMT; air-conditioning systems must be free of ozone-depleting refrigerants; general solid waste is handed over to the municipal urban environment company.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire prevention and fighting certificate (approval/acceptance) issued under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP for the head office, with annual maintenance and re-validation; structural load and occupancy safety confirmed by the building owner's certificate; occupational safety and hygiene clearance under Law No. 84/2015/QH13 including employee health checks, hazard identification, workplace risk assessment, safety signage and designation of a workplace safety officer; civil defense coordination through the local ward-level police for the building evacuation plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; official digital portals: www.gdt.gov.vn, thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-tax filing), hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-invoice clearance), dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn (National Business Registration Portal, administered jointly with the Department of Planning and Investment).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC obtains a single enterprise tax identification number (Mã số thuế - MST) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn). This MST functions as the unified TIN and VAT ID for all tax administrations. Required follow-up steps: (1) file a statutory tax registration dossier (Form 01-ĐK-TCT) with the local Tax Department (Cục Thuế) within 10 working days after the ERC date; (2) activate the e-tax taxpayer account at thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn and register all transactional bank accounts with the tax authority within 15 days of account opening; (3) register an electronic-invoice principal mailbox at hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn and either self-generate invoice codes or be assigned GDT invoice codes for each issued e-invoice; (4) submit the official-seal registration and digital signature certification to the tax office; (5) finalize the LLC's tax registration dossier within 10 working days of any subsequent amendment. No separate VAT certificate is issued; the MST and Enterprise Registration Certificate are conclusive evidence of tax registration for a resident LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope - A VN-incorporated LLC is a resident corporate taxpayer subject to enterprise income tax (CIT) at the standard 20% rate on worldwide income; no pass-through or transparent fiscal treatment exists under the Enterprise Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and the Tax Administration Law No. 38/2019/QH14. Non-resident shareholders' Vietnam-source income is separately taxed through the Foreign Contractor Tax withholding mechanism where applicable. The LLC's status cannot be altered to a partnership or disregarded entity. Certain investment-incentive projects may enjoy CIT exemption/reduction as an entity-level benefit, but the fundamental entity-level taxation model is immutable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not provide a U.S.-style 'check-the-box' election, hybrid-mismatch election, or transparent-entity election for an LLC whose legal form is fixed by the Enterprise Law. Available elections and electable regimes include: (A) segment-by-segment CIT incentive elections (e.g., high-tech, supporting-industry, or special-zone projects) including exemption-and-reduction schedules to be claimed on the final CIT annual return; (B) elective quarterly VAT declaration (instead of monthly) where the prior-year revenue does not exceed VND 50 billion, under Article 9 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC as amended; (C) election of a 365-day fiscal year differing from the calendar year, with prior approval; (D) election of the Advance Pricing Agreement route under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP for related-party transactions; and (E) voluntary application of the GDT's pre-clearance e-invoice scheme for low-risk taxpayers. All elections are procedural or incentive-based; they do not alter entity-level tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT - Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng), administered under Law on VAT No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Laws No. 31/2013/QH13 and No. 106/2016/QH13, with implementing Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC and Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For resident LLCs there is no economic turnover threshold: VAT registration is mandatory at incorporation and effective immediately upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. For unincorporated household businesses, the statutory registration threshold is VND 100,000,000 (one hundred million) annual revenue. Non-resident digital suppliers without a Vietnamese legal presence must register for VAT through the GDT foreign-supplier portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) once they derive Vietnam-source revenue, without a statutory turnover threshold under Decree No. 85/2021/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular No. 78/2021/TT-BTC, fully effective from 1 July 2022: every invoice must be issued as an e-invoice, digitally signed and transmitted to the GDT e-invoice portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) in real time upon issuance. For the default regime, each e-invoice must carry a unique GDT-generated tax-authority code issued through the central vAT-einvoice clearing system; qualifying low-risk taxpayers may self-generate invoice codes but remain obligated to transmit 100% of invoice XML data to the GDT immediately after issuance. Fiscal 'stamping' is replaced by the tax-authority invoice code and the digital signature of the seller; no physical fiscal stamp is affixed. Customs export declarations must be processed through the VNACCS/VCIS national single-window system. Retail-cash-register-linked e-invoicing may apply to certain high-risk B2C activities, but for advisory services zero-rating claims, the governing obligation is full electronic traceability of 0% invoices in the GDT portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate is available strictly under Article 9 of Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC for (i) exported tangible goods and goods sold to non-tariff-zone traders/export-processing enterprises, and (ii) services supplied to foreign organizations or individuals which are consumed outside Viet Nam. For a Government-affairs-lobbying and trade-policy advisory LLC (ISIC 7020 / NAICS 541820), zero-rating requires a contractual supply to a non-resident principal with documentary proof that the service is performed and conceived for use exclusively offshore. Advisory output, policy analysis, or advocacy that is delivered, used, or benefited by persons within Viet Nam, including lobbying of Vietnamese authorities on behalf of a foreign principal, is not zero-rated and bears the 10% standard VAT. The taxpayer bears the full burden of producing an 'export service dossier' proving the non-resident counterparty, the offshore place of consumption, and the actual receipt of consideration in foreign currency.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronically lodged on VNACCS/VCIS and validated by Customs) - mandatory for goods exports
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / international carriage document evidencing physical departure of goods from Viet Nam
Export sales contract between the LLC and the foreign buyer, including payment terms and Incoterms (for services: contract with the non-resident principal stipulating offshore consumption)
Commercial invoice together with the GDT-coded e-invoice expressly stating the 0% VAT rate
Inward Remittance Certificate (Giấy báo Có / Swift / NH Form) issued by the Vietnamese bank or foreign correspondent bank confirming receipt of the export proceeds from abroad
For advisory services: statement/certificate from the foreign recipient confirming exclusive consumption outside Viet Nam, supported by underlying work product and performance records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT and Customs Service conduct targeted post-export audit campaigns on professional services and advisory zero-rating claims, applying strict substance-over-form examinations. Consequences of disallowance or fraud: (a) under-declared VAT is assessed as a deficiency of 20% of the understated tax plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day under Articles 141 and 143 of Law No. 38/2019/QH14; (b) fraudulent zero-rating or refund fabrication constitutes tax evasion subject to an administrative penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount, suspension of the taxpayer's e-invoice codes, and issuance of forced-collection decisions under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP; (c) criminal liability may attach under Article 200 of the Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13 (as amended in 2017) for the LLC's responsible officers where the evasion exceeds VND 100 million, with imprisonment penalties of up to 7 years; (d) wrongly received VAT refunds are clawed back in full with 0.03% daily interest under a five-year general lookback period, extended to ten years for fraud; (e) failure to repatriate export earnings within the 180-day statutory deadline triggers foreign-exchange-control fines of VND 50 million to VND 100 million, compulsory repatriation, and late-repatriation interest under Circular No. 05/2018/TT-NHNN. All export substantiation files must be retained not less than 5 years (10 years where fraud indicators exist).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), acting as the monetary and foreign-exchange administrative authority through its Foreign Exchange Administration Department, supported by the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended by Ordinance No. 06/2013/UBTVQH14, the Law on Credit Institutions, and subordinate SBV Circulars, including Circular No. 09/2022/TT-NHNN on Direct Investment Capital Accounts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VND is not fully freely convertible. Current-account transactions, including service fees, advisory retainers, and cross-border consultancy disbursements, are generally convertible and may be settled through SBV-licensed credit institutions without advance SBV approval, provided the underlying commercial contracts, invoices, tax records, and FX purpose declarations are complete. Capital-account transactions, including FDI equity contribution, share transfer proceeds, medium-term and long-term external loans, and capital repatriation, are subject to evidentiary restrictions and must be routed through the enterprise's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed bank. Profit remittance abroad is legally permitted after compliance with annual audited financial statements, corporate income tax finalization, statutory reserve allocations, settlement of all tax and social insurance obligations, and submission of the required bank-facing documentary set. In practice, unresolved tax audits or transfer-pricing exposure and foreign contractor tax filing gaps constitute the principal remittance hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For export receipts of goods or services, the Vietnamese foreign-exchange framework imposes an inward-repatriation obligation: export proceeds must be collected and brought into the Vietnamese banking system within the statutory deadline, generally 90 days from the export date or the contractual payment due date, and must be credited to the LLC's foreign-currency account at a SBV-licensed authorized bank. There is no mandatory conversion ratio for private export earnings of a foreign-invested LLC under the current regime; the LLC may retain the proceeds in foreign currency, but any conversion to VND must be executed through a licensed bank at the prevailing spot rate. If the statutory repatriation deadline cannot be met, a written extension application must be submitted to the SBV before the deadline lapses, supported by the underlying cross-border contract, collection status report, and bank transaction proof. Offshore retention, offshore set-off against payables, or evasion of the repatriation route is not permitted.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (DICA) + VND Operational Current Account + USD Clearing Account
Capital Escrow Account (DICA) + VND Operational Current Account + USD Clearing Account
Capital Escrow Account (DICA) + VND Operational Current Account + USD Clearing Account
DICA + Operational VND/USD Accounts + Trade Settlement and FX Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Revolut Business, or Payoneer cannot act as the primary corporate treasury or cross-border clearing bank for a Vietnamese foreign-invested LLC. Vietnamese law reserves the provision of payment accounts, settlement services, and foreign-exchange clearing activity to SBV-licensed credit institutions and certain licensed payment intermediaries. An offshore EMI may serve only as an ancillary collection channel for small external service fees; it cannot lawfully receive the LLC's FDI equity capital, cannot maintain an onshore VND settlement account, and cannot issue SBV-recognized FX documentation. The LLC must establish and maintain its root clearing relationship through an SBV-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is required. At least one authorized signatory, ordinarily the chairman or a finance director holding a valid notarized power of attorney executed by all LLC members, must attend the bank in person at account opening to complete statutory customer identification and the AML interview. Digital and video verification may be used as a pre-screening enhancement but does not replace the in-person branch visit. Fully remote account opening for a foreign-invested LLC is not practically accepted by SBV-regulated banks. Foreign directors may delegate under a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney; each signatory must present an original passport, Vietnam visa/residence evidence, and any company authorization resolutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The advisory business line concerns government affairs/lobbying, creating heightened suspicion of political-influence activity, PEP relationships, and corruption exposure from the bank underwriting perspective.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: (1) company charter recording a lawful business line under the Enterprise Law such as business and trade-policy consulting, avoiding unlicensed political-lobby terminology; (2) executed client engagement agreements with a strict scope of work limited to research, policy-analysis drafting, public-affairs advisory, and advocacy communications that expressly exclude payments to government officials; (3) complete UBO register, member register, and passports of natural-person owners; (4) anti-bribery/anti-corruption compliance manual containing PEP screening, gift/hospitality limits, zero-tolerance policy, and annual certification; (5) independent Vietnamese legal opinion stating that no separate conditional licensing obligation applies beyond the standard enterprise registration and applicable trade/consulting business licenses.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholders, a multi-tier offshore parent structure, or low domestic substance despite the entity's Vietnamese tax-resident status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide: (1) organizational chart showing the direct parent and ultimate beneficial owner; (2) Vietnamese office lease, invoices, and utility bills demonstrating physical substance; (3) employment contracts and social insurance records for local operations personnel; (4) board resolution approving the bank account opening and designated signatories; (5) tax certificate and recent corporate tax filings; (6) parent auditor letter explaining economic substance, group function, and transfer-pricing policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value retainer wires from foreign government-linked entities, state-owned enterprises, or politically connected clients can appear to be compensation for unlawful procurement, licensing, or rulemaking access.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: For each engagement provide: (1) signed advisory agreement with fee mechanics not linked to any government outcome; (2) itemized invoices aligned to monthly/hourly deliverables; (3) substantive work records including meeting minutes, policy memoranda, comment letters, communication logs, and time sheets; (4) bank statements showing collection only by the LLC and no third-party pass-through; (5) board declaration that neither the LLC nor any member has offered, promised, or solicited any bribe, commission, or facilitation payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening alerts triggered by the ultimate client's jurisdiction, board composition, or ownership chain in high-risk or sanctioned countries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Produce: (1) institutional sanctions-screening output for UN, EU, UK, OFAC, and national lists applied to all members, clients, and payers; (2) geographical engagement matrix demonstrating lawful cross-border business routes; (3) client-side KYC pack containing ownership, board composition, proof of address, business registration, and source of funds; (4) legal counsel confirmation that the proposed transaction does not breach sanctions, export-control, or anticorruption law; (5) written commitment to seek the bank's prior approval before onboarding any additional foreign government-related counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through transactions or settlement from a third party not named in the contract or invoice, creating a 'funds from unknown sources' concern and a potential suspicious-transaction-report trigger.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a treasury file containing: (1) client-side payment authorization identifying the actual payer and its legal relationship to the client; (2) chain-of-funds explanation and wire confirmation showing the ultimate economic originator; (3) reconciliation mapping each payment to exactly one invoice and one engagement; (4) board-approved treasury policy disallowing sweep/settlement accounts and requiring direct payers only; (5) source-of-wealth documentation collected during onboarding; (6) prompt evidence package delivered to the bank upon any AML inquiry.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI equity subscriptions must be wired into the LLC's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an SBV-licensed bank. The foreign investor issues a SWIFT MT103 with remittance information containing the investor's legal name, the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) number, the purpose of payment, and the relevant purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment — Equity Capital'. The receiving bank verifies: (i) the IRC is authentic and unexpired; (ii) the contribution is within the charter-capital schedule and does not exceed the registered capital; (iii) the investor's corporate identity and UBO; (iv) compliance with the statutory capital-contribution deadline, generally 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance; and (v) the source-of-funds documentation. Once cleared, the funds are booked onshore: the LLC may hold the foreign currency or convert into VND at the applicable spot rate. Withdrawals from the DICA to the operating account are permitted only for lawful expenditure supported by invoices, contracts, payroll records, and tax filings. No offshore conversion, no settlement through a third-party offshore account, and no capital credit directly to the operating account is permissible. If the injected amount exceeds the original charter capital, an updated IRC and Department of Planning and Investment approval must be obtained before the remittance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements to foreign advisory firms and trade counterparties are executed from the LLC's operational bank accounts, not from the DICA. The standard clearing rail is SWIFT MT103: the LLC submits a payment order with a purpose code reflecting the nature of the cross-border transaction, such as business consulting or advisory services, together with the underlying commercial contract, itemized invoice, service acceptance certificate, and, where applicable, evidence of Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) withholding and settlement. For imported goods, the LLC may open an irrevocable commercial letter of credit through its credit line, or use a sight documentary collection where no credit line exists. Every outbound payment must be matched to one invoice and one engagement; the LLC must maintain continuously updated treasury files containing VAT receipts, tax remittance confirmations, FX spot confirmations, and proof of bank-authorization references. The LLC should aggregate USD-denominated payables and settle them in a single spot purchase through the licensed bank to minimize conversion cost and demonstrate real-demand compliance. Related-party cross-border payments must be supported by transfer-pricing documentation and legal substance evidence to avoid tax-adjustment risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable over-the-counter FX forward contracts (USD/VND) with an SBV-licensed commercial bank, supported by an actual underlying receipt or payment obligation and executed only for real-demand hedging.
FX swaps between USD and VND executed at a licensed bank, each leg matched to the enterprise's operational currency needs, such as managing capital inflows, payroll, and trade settlements.

Cross-currency swaps for hedging principal and interest exposure on foreign-currency-denominated medium- or long-term loans, executed only with an SBV-licensed credit institution under ISDA/CSA or equivalent documentation.

OTC FX options (plain-vanilla USD/VND calls and puts) offered by a licensed bank when the bank has derivative-dealing approval, and where the notional, strike, premium, and tenor are tied to a due-dated underlying commercial transaction.
Interest-rate swaps or fixings that hedge only the interest-rate risk of the LLC's external borrowings, not speculative positions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal, Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year enterprises no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 10,000,000–20,000,000 (approx. USD 400–800) under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP for late or non-filing; repeated violation may trigger forced dissolution and strike-off of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Implementation Report (Báo cáo tình hình thực hiện dự án đầu tư)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or Management Board of the Economic Zone / Industrial Zone, Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 March per Decree 31/2021/ND-CP and the Law on Investment 2020; quarterly milestones (15 Apr / 15 Jul / 15 Oct) also apply while the project is in operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate reporting is subject to administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; persistent non-reporting may lead to suspension or revocation of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Tax Finalization Dossiers (CIT and PIT finalization returns)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) / local Provincial Tax Department under the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year enterprises no later than 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines of VND 2,800,000–12,000,000 (approx. USD 110–480) for returns with no tax due, and VND 8,000,000–25,000,000 (approx. USD 320–1,000) for returns with tax due; late-payment interest at 0.03% per day on unpaid amounts; enforcement can include suspension of invoice documents and banking account constraints.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Tax Declaration and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department / national tax e-portal under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration and payment no later than 30 January of each calendar year; newly formed license-tax payers must file within 30 days of ERC issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day plus administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; consistent non-payment serves as a ground for administrative enforcement and involuntary corporate strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã được kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment, General Department of Taxation, and Ministry of Finance; retained locally for shareholder and banking purposes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submission of audited financial statements with the annual tax finalization dossier no later than 31 March for calendar-year enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or non-audited statements trigger administrative fines under Decree 41/2018/ND-CP and Decree 122/2021/ND-CP (VND 20,000,000–50,000,000 approx. USD 800–2,000); may additionally trigger tax assessment adjustments, late-payment interest, and loss of business facilitation privileges.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all foreign-invested enterprises (100% foreign-owned and joint ventures) regardless of turnover, asset size, or headcount under the Law on Enterprise 2020 and Law on Investment 2020; also mandatory for public companies, state-owned enterprises, credit institutions, insurance and securities firms; private domestic LLCs below statutory thresholds are audited only when shareholders so resolve or a lender/partner requires it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) applied under Law on Accounting 2015 and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (general enterprise regime) or Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC (small-and-medium enterprise regime); IFRS adoption is permitted for consolidated financial statements of eligible parent groups per the MOF roadmap and local GAAP reconciliation rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam has no standalone annual UBO register filing for LLCs; under the Anti-Money Laundering Law 2022 and Decree 12/2023/ND-CP the enterprise must identify and preserve beneficial-owner records at formation and update them within 30 days of any shareholding transfer. For a foreign-invested LLC, any membership or ownership change requires DPI approval and re-issuance of the IRC and ERC; financial institutions additionally collect an annual UBO confirmation during KYC reviews.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (list of members and capital contribution percentages)
Register of Directors / Member's Council members and legal representatives
Minute Book (Member's Council and Management Board resolutions)
